title: Transformer on dose-dependent transcriptomic profiles predicts compound activity
summary: TAT models for 2692 compounds gave useful models for 51% of 262 dose-response assays on a held-out set, and a 63% hit rate in a prospective malaria assay with submicromolar inhibitors.
ai_technology: Transcriptomics-to-activity transformer (TAT) on RASL-seq dose-response profiles
organization: Novartis Institutes for BioMedical Research, Emeryville, USA

evidence.tested: Held-out set plus prospective malaria assay
evidence.unknown: Abstract only; full text not reviewed.
